Motion / animation beats: Ganesh uses the approved crown, feather, yellow dhoti and gold jewellery. Rat is grey-brown, one-third Ganesh height, red-gold waistcoat and yellow scarf. Modak is a separate golden prop.
Interaction / logic: Lock a single scale, light direction and transparent background standard before any frames are made.
Art frames required: Ganesh idle x4; rat idle/sniff x4; modak idle x2
Acceptance check: No shadow; no background; no cropped ear, crown, tail or feet; no style changes between clips.

On-screen actors and layers: Rat only; no Ganesh; no modak
Motion / animation beats: Walk; sniff left; pause; look up; walk right; tail flick. Use variable pauses so it feels alive.
Interaction / logic: Loop while no modak is discovered. Randomly choose one of three screen lanes and reverse before a desktop edge.
Acceptance check: Rat never teleports, clips into an edge or leaves a trail.

Motion / animation beats: Rat notices modak; ears lift; head turn; two cautious steps; sniff; delighted smile.
Interaction / logic: Spawn modak 80-140 px ahead of rat, never underneath it. Rat must turn toward the prop before moving.
Acceptance check: Exactly one modak; it remains a separate sprite with an uninterrupted path.

Motion / animation beats: Rat reaches; cups modak; lifts it; looks both ways; tiny anticipation crouch.
Interaction / logic: At the grab frame parent modak to rat paw anchor. Set rat_has_modak=true and reveal the button: Take Modak from Rat.
Acceptance check: No hand/prop merge before grab; modak remains visible after grab.

On-screen actors and layers: Ganesh far layer; rat with modak far opposite
Motion / animation beats: Ganesh starts small at the opposite side; sees the modak; head/eye turn; smile; points gently; prepares to run.
Interaction / logic: This starts once after the rat picks up the modak. It is not a duplicate Ganesh sprite: use a scale/depth variant or a small distant pose.
Acceptance check: Clear large distance between actors; Ganesh looks at the modak, not directly at the rat.

Motion / animation beats: Rat fidgets with modak while waiting; Ganesh holds an alert ready pose at a distance.
Interaction / logic: Button label: Take Modak from Rat. Click starts chase. If untouched for 15 seconds, show gentle pulse only; do not auto-catch.
Acceptance check: Button does not cover either sprite and works once only.

Motion / animation beats: Rat runs with modak; Ganesh begins at a slower jog. Both are independent screen objects on separate movement paths.
Interaction / logic: Set chase_elapsed=0. Rat speed 85 px/s; Ganesh 68 px/s; maintain 180-300 px gap.
Acceptance check: No overlap; no merged sprites; movement uses real x/y positions rather than a baked combined image.

Motion / animation beats: Rat accelerates, glances back, takes one curved turn; Ganesh changes lane and gains slowly. Alternate left/right run cycles.
Interaction / logic: Every 6-10 seconds choose a safe turn before the edge. Rat 90-118 px/s; Ganesh 88-122 px/s. Keep 110 px minimum gap until final act.
Acceptance check: Both sprites stay fully inside visible desktop bounds; modak follows paw anchor; no repeated identical turn sequence.

Motion / animation beats: Rat tires slightly; Ganesh closes gap; rat makes a final small hop; Ganesh reaches with open cupped hands.
Interaction / logic: Reduce rat speed to 74 px/s and let Ganesh gain. Pause both at least 24 px from screen edge before catch begins.
Acceptance check: Do not catch tail or body abruptly. Rat and Ganesh remain separate until the hand-contact frame.

Motion / animation beats: Ganesh kneels or sits; hands cup the rat safely; rat smiles; modak remains between paws.
Interaction / logic: Swap from free-moving rat to rat_in_hands pose only when overlap-safe hand anchors align. Stop chase timer and clear movement queues.
Acceptance check: No body merge, clipped tail or duplicated modak. Catch can be cancelled cleanly if DeskPal is dragged.

Motion / animation beats: Ganesh offers the modak; both smile; rat takes a tiny bite; calm shared happy pose; return to idle.
Interaction / logic: Set scene_complete=true; hide button; unlock another roaming story after a cooldown.
Acceptance check: Warm ending, one modak only, no food inside body, no persistent effect or shadow.

On-screen actors and layers: Independent Ganesh; independent rat; independent modak; optional UI
Motion / animation beats: Use one finite-state controller: ROAM > DISCOVER > HOLD > READY > CHASE > CATCH > SHARE > IDLE. Each actor has its own animation clock and movement anchor.
Interaction / logic: Cancel to IDLE on drag, hide, app quit, low FPS or missing art. Never fall back to a different random photo; use approved idle pose.
Art frames required: Asset manifest with exact filename, size, anchor and facing direction
Acceptance check: Every PNG decodes; transparent corners; no edge debris; test on light and dark wallpapers; test click, timeout, drag and restart.
